basic_profile.bio: I'm an airman in the U.S. Air Force, currently stationed in California. I've been in the service for a little over a year and I'm eager to learn more about managing my finances, especially when it comes to investing for my future. Outside of work, I have a passion for Brazilian music and enjoy exploring new playlists online. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm single and spend a good chunk of my free time either playing guitar or exploring investment options like the Thrift Savings Plan.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of investment principles, mostly learned from online resources and personal research. My interest in finance was piqued when I joined the Air Force, and I've been trying to educate myself on the best ways to save and invest, especially using tools available to service members.
